latestUpdate.label: Latest Session · Kyrn Facility Breach
latestUpdate.excerpt: A 5,552-word continuation of the Imp Ambush with tactical battle record, 2,880 XP rewards, relation links, Waluigi theories, cell carvings, Kyrn, Gregir Fendelsohn, and Remi repairing Mossy.

didYouKnow: ...that the Mount Ebott Survey Part III file now has XP awards and reputation deltas for Gamma Agent, Dracule Mihawk, Sans, Koffin-K, Flowey, and Asgore? Waluigi calls this “finally doing the paperwork.”

...that Sans saying “the war” may be evidence of memory suppression rather than ordinary forgetfulness? Waluigi has upgraded the Ebott file from “spooky cave trip” to “possible historical erasure incident.”
...that Flowey repaired the Legion survey machine to 98% integrity and left a vine behind like a signature? This is not plant behavior. This is audit behavior.

...that Corvinarus's 10-page codex predicted Disaster Inc.'s exact seating arrangements 80 years in advance—naming the 'one-armed shadow' (Dan), the 'fire that bleeds' (Archie), and the 'green one taking the children's table' (Green T)?
...that Thornbury charged Archie 2,062 gold and 5 silver for a broken hempen rope and converted it into an official Imperial Bounty across state lines?
...that Bones grabbed a multi-ton Yugoloth Canoloth's spiny tongue bare-handed and physically hauled it toward a cliff edge? Waluigi calls this raw kinetic insanity.
...that Alpine Bank enforces monetary warfare by refusing Mushroom Kingdom coins ('mushroom coins won't work') to force refugees into taking Imperial Midland Ducats?
...that the Toad God warned Bones to keep the Oracle alive and leave Raventree Manor divided to stop 'pesky star bears' from giving away their stars?
...that Bones is on the Iron Legion's Most Wanted list for allegedly 'strangling a toad on the Vigilance'? Waluigi blames administrative clerical incompetence.
...that Waluigi’s Front Page Desk now monitors 48 international currencies, ranging from Gold Pieces and Mora to Soul Coins and Wario Coins?
...that Wario's shop catalog now contains over 7,880 individual items across 14 realms? Waluigi checked the inventory personally and demands a cut!
...that Remi Akamatsu stole her gun back from Markop during a 3 AM intrusion at the Shadow Estate? Never come between an artificer and her firearms!
...that Archie Miser calls himself 'Darman Knightly' in the Shadowfell? It's the stupidest name I've ever heard. Also, he cut off a guy's finger!
...that the Grand Latin Assembly now processes viral propaganda feeds and infamy scores for 100 different polities? Waluigi calls this high-yield bureaucracy.
...that there are 9 Cosmic Star Bearers and a God Toad holding star fragment artifacts across the universe?
...that the Airship was full of Toads in barrels? The Iron Legion calls it 'Trafficking,' Wario calls it 'Efficient Packaging.' Potay-to, Potah-to.
...that Wario priced a Star Rod at 900 trillion coins? That is a very fair market price. No low-ball offers! I know what I have!
...that the Oracle keeps bodies in tanks? Disgusting! Science is for nerds who can't get rich honest ways (like stealing).
onThisDay: 10XX BF — Mount Ebott Survey Part III: Sans slips about “the war,” Koffin-K joins an unauthorized Iron Legion team, Flowey is captured, and the repaired Legion survey machine is left in the abandoned Snowdin police station.

1040 BF — Deep Mirror Sanctum & Alpine Bank Crisis: Bones loots Corvinarus's codex, bare-hand drags a Canoloth, meets the Toad God, eavesdrops on Thornbury's 2,062-gold rope bounty at Alpine Bank, and retreats into a mountain blizzard to a 3-ducat inn room.
955 BF — Princess Peach takes a permanent nap. Everyone is still crying about it. Get over it!
1035 BF — The Iron Legion starts ruining everyone's fun with 'laws' and 'taxes'.
1040 BF — We killed a dragon! Well, *they* did, but I provided moral support (and looted the hoard).
1040 BF — The Planar Fracture happens. The universe breaks just to annoy me personally.
1040 BF — The Mirror of True Reflection is restored in the Shadow Estate, all four portal artifacts are secured, and the exit is immediately occupied by enemies because happiness is illegal.
1040 BF — Midnight Audit of the Shadow Estate: Remi Akamatsu steals her gun back, confronts a closet-soldier, and acquires a lie-detecting crystal. Waluigi's safety desk is overwhelmed. WAH.
10XX BF — The Iron Legion breaches the treaty layers of Mount Ebott, establishing a survey mission in the hidden village of Snowdin. Skeletons and casseroles are involved.

editorialDirective.title: WAH! Editorial Directive (1040 BF):
editorialDirective.text: The Imp Ambush did not end at Tymnas’s cottage! Eager dropped Salam with a whip, Dan smote an imp, Rattles threw Salam through a window, and Remi escaped Kyrn’s facility with one hit point and a repaired Mossy. File the 2,880 XP preview, track the stolen Black Crystal and Mirror, and stop calling an unlocked prison a security system! WAH!
